name: Biceps Pulley Lesion of the Shoulder
tags: biceps pulley lesion of the shoulder
definition: Injury of the stabilizing soft tissues around the long head of biceps tendon in the rotator interval, often associated with subscapularis or labral pathology.

investigations.principle: MRI/MR arthrography or ultrasound may identify biceps instability and associated cuff injury.
investigations.MRI: Use MRI when neural, soft-tissue, labral, tendon, ligament, infection, occult injury or other condition-specific assessment requires it.
investigations.radiographs: Use radiographs and/or CT according to the condition-specific diagnostic pathway.

amber: Persistent structural biceps instability may require tenodesis or repair depending on associated pathology.
red: Urgent red-flag features override routine conservative or Ayurvedic pathways.

patientEducation.summary: Injury of the stabilizing soft tissues around the long head of biceps tendon in the rotator interval, often associated with subscapularis or labral pathology.
patientEducation.urgent: Seek urgent assessment for acute neurovascular compromise, major trauma, rapidly progressive weakness, suspected serious infection, airway/vascular symptoms, unreduced dislocation or other listed red flags.
